serviceIntro.subtitle: Our service is structured in two parts: core visa placement services and a five-year employment guarantee. Here is what each part includes.
serviceIntro.mainSubtitle: Covered by the primary service fee
mainItems: Provide and secure a 482 employer nomination on your behalf
Provide and secure a 186 employer nomination on your behalf
RedBridge does not participate in salary negotiations between you and the employer
Your specific job duties and compensation are determined directly between you and the employer
A 5-year employment contract is included as part of the arrangement
serviceIntro.guaranteeDesc: The service guarantee covers employment continuity and proactive management throughout your five-year service period, ensuring you remain in genuine, paid employment.
guaranteeItems: Regular check-ins with the employer to confirm your active on-site presence and role performance
Periodic salary review every 3–6 months to ensure continued compliance and market alignment

If you are unable to continue in your current position due to a role mismatch, we will assist with a job adjustment or employer transfer to maintain your genuine employment status throughout the service period
